svg.text: LESSON GUIDE: HOW TO FIND THE LEAST COMMON MULTIPLE (LCM)
Step-by-Step Hands-On Tutorial: Finding LCM(12, 18) = 36 & The Law of Conservation of Primes
SERIES 1 • CARD 05 OF 12 • DOMAIN: FUNDAMENTAL THEOREM OF ARITHMETIC

text.tspan: Which prime blocks are shared by

g.text: Seat each tower in the 12-socket lid tray.
Identify the blocks they share in common
Shared Overlap: Exactly one [2] and one
3. TAKE PRIME UNION: Take highest power of each prime: two [2]s, two [3]s.
Calculator Verification: Press Factor Tree Icon ([PRIME] / [g][FACT]) and run 12 [ENTER]
CORE PRINCIPLE: CONSERVATION OF PRIMES: A × B = GCD × LCM
Multiply Tower 12 and Tower 18: you have three [2]s and three [3]s. Look at your GCD Tower
([2], [3]) and your LCM Tower ([2]², [3]²): together they contain the EXACT same prime
Therefore: A × B = GCD(A, B) × LCM(A, B) = 6 × 36 = 216!
Build Tower 8: [2]+[2]+[2] and Tower 12: [2]+[2]+[3]. Prime union takes three [2]s and one
